problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate shipments from seven distribution hubs to seven retail outlets, minimizing overall freight expenses.

The inventory available at each hub (set H) is as follows:  
*Hub Alpha's stock is 122.  
*Hub Beta's stock is 174.  
*Hub Gamma's stock is 184.  
*Hub Delta's stock is 128.  
*Hub Epsilon's stock is 61.  
*Hub Zeta's stock is 106.  
*Hub Eta's stock is 151.

The required fulfillment at each retail outlet (set R) is specified below:  
*Outlet R1 requires 16 units.  
*Outlet R2 requires 57 units.  
*Outlet R3 requires 263 units.  
*Outlet R4 requires 213 units.  
*Outlet R5 requires 212 units.  
*Outlet R6 requires 80 units.  
*Outlet R7 requires 33 units.

The per-unit freight cost from each hub to each outlet is detailed in the table:

| From / To | R1 | R2 | R3 | R4 | R5 | R6 | R7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Alpha   | 16 | 14 | 6  | 5  | 13 | 18 | 8  |
| Beta    | 17 | 18 | 12 | 3  | 13 | 2  | 14 |
| Gamma   | 1  | 15 | 3  | 11 | 19 | 14 | 19 |
| Delta   | 13 | 14 | 10 | 4  | 13 | 1  | 11 |
| Epsilon | 6  | 20 | 15 | 12 | 3  | 14 | 4  |
| Zeta    | 8  | 14 | 19 | 13 | 17 | 3  | 13 |
| Eta     | 10 | 11 | 8  | 11 | 6  | 3  | 17 |

Determine the optimal shipment quantities to achieve the minimal total freight expenditure.
